job.title: Clinical Research Associate II
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm's Healthcare Division is partnering with a world leading organisation in the Biotechnology industry to hire a Clinical Research Associate II to be based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

As a Clinical Research Associate II, you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

Job Responsibilities:
• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings
• resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
• Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. May help to identify potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
• Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
• Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the team as required. Ensures study systems are complete, accurate and updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
• Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and internal project teams through written, oral and/or electronic contacts. Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
• Maintains and completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
• Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Job Requirements:
Education and Experience Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
• Minimal clinical monitoring experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2 years) in a clinical environment where experience is gained in clinical trials, medical terminology, medical research, clinical research or health care or experience in a health sciences field with formal training in medical terminology and anatomy may be considered.
• Valid driver's license where applicable.
In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Basic medical/therapeutic area knowledge and understanding of medical terminology
• Ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs and applicable regulations and procedural documents
• Good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
• Good interpersonal skills
• Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
• Good organizational and time management skills
• Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
• Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
• Ability to manage Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
• Ability to work in a team or independently as required
• Good computer skills: solid knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
• Good English language and grammar skills

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Work is performed in an office/clinical/and/or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
• Frequent drives to site locations. Frequent travel, generally 60-80% but more for some individuals. May also include extended overnight stays.
• Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
• Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.

job.title: Commercial QA Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting is partnering with a global medical device company to recruit a Commercial Quality Assurance (QA) Manager – Indonesia. This position will play a key role in establishing, implementing, and maintaining the Quality Management System (QMS) for the Indonesia commercial operations, ensuring compliance with local medical device regulations and global quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish, implement, and maintain the Indonesia Commercial Quality Management System (QMS) in alignment with local regulatory requirements and global quality standards.
  • Serve as Penanggung Jawab Teknis (PJT) and ensure day-to-day compliance with applicable MOH/BPOM requirements.
  • Manage key QMS activities including document control, training, quality metrics, management review, and internal/external audits.
  • Ensure compliance with CDAKB, ISO 13485:2016, and other applicable medical device quality and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead and coordinate MOH/BPOM inspections and external audits, ensuring continuous audit readiness.
  • Manage non-conformance investigations and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
  • Support complaint handling, post-market surveillance, and third-party quality oversight.
  • Monitor regulatory and quality-related changes in Indonesia and assess their potential impact on business operations.
  • Partner with regional and local cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for continuous quality and process improvement.
  • Provide Quality Assurance support for business expansion, new facilities/sites, and other assigned projects.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Science, or another scientific discipline recognized by the relevant authorities, with eligibility to serve as PJT.
  • Minimum 8 years of Quality Assurance experience within regulated healthcare industries.
  • At least 3 years of experience in Medical Device Quality Assurance.
  • Strong understanding of MOH/BPOM regulations, CDAKB, and ISO 13485:2016.
  • ISO 13485:2016 Auditor certification would be an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in QMS implementation and maintenance, audits, CAPA, and regulatory compliance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across local and regional teams.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced and evolving business environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to develop practical, well-considered solutions.

job.title: Head of AI Engineering
job.description:

Position Overview

Lead the organisation's AI engineering and application development function, driving the delivery of scalable digital platforms and intelligent technology solutions.

Provide technical leadership, people management, and strategic direction to ensure high-quality software delivery, innovation, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Software Development Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of AI and software developers.
  • Provide technical guidance and oversight across AI-powered applications and enterprise digital platforms.
  • Drive the adoption of best practices in software engineering, solution architecture, code quality, testing, and deployment.
  • Support the development of intelligent automation solutions, AI-enabled workflows, AI agents, and emerging technology initiatives.

Application & Platform Management

  • Oversee the development, enhancement, and maintenance of web, mobile, and enterprise applications.
  • Lead application modernisation and platform optimisation initiatives.
  • Ensure digital products remain scalable, secure, and aligned with business requirements.
  • Collaborate with architecture and infrastructure teams to define technology strategies and roadmaps.

Technical Delivery

  • Manage end-to-end software delivery from requirements gathering through deployment and post-launch support.
  • Review technical designs, engineering standards, and solution architectures.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to translate operational requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  • Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

Team & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary people leader for the AI and software engineering team.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performing engineering culture.
  • Partner closely with technology leadership, business stakeholders, architects, and external partners.
  • Provide regular updates on project progress, resource planning, risks, and delivery milestones.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 8-15 years of software engineering experience, including a minimum of 3 years in a people leadership role.
  • Proven experience managing software development, engineering, or technology delivery teams.
  • Strong experience delivering enterprise applications, digital platforms, or business-critical technology solutions.
  • Experience operating within complex technology environments and supporting digital transformation initiatives.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices and application development methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Java-based backend development.
  • Familiarity with React Native or modern frontend and mobile application frameworks.
  • Experience working with cloud-native applications and enterprise technology platforms.
  • Exposure to Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI, Agentic AI, or intelligent automation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of API integrations, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and modern software delivery methodologies.
  • Ability to review solution architecture, technical designs, and engineering best practices.
  • Knowledge of platform scalability, security, performance optimisation, and enterprise application architecture.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing engineering teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to effectively engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Hands-on and pragmatic leadership style.
  • Ability to drive delivery while balancing business priorities and technical excellence.
  • Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-paced, and evolving environments.
  • Mandarin and English proficiency preferred to support regional stakeholder communication.

job.title: Regional Product Support Engineer - Network and Systems
job.description:
Regional Product Support Engineer - Network and Systems

Introduction
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Regional Product Support Engineer – Farm Management & Network. This opportunity is based in Klang, Malaysia.

Position Overview
This role is responsible for providing advanced, escalation-level technical support across farm management and network systems, ensuring reliable deployment, compliance, and continuous improvement of engineering solutions. It plays a critical part in strengthening regional technical standards and driving product reliability across country operations.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Technical Support (Escalation-Level)

  • Resolve complex hardware, software, connectivity, and system-level issues escalated by country Service teams.
  • Troubleshoot advanced farm network setups (LAN, Wi-Fi, gateways, routers, long range links, interference).
  • Lead root cause investigations and coordinate corrective actions with Global/Asia Engineering and suppliers.
  • Support key deployments, pilots, and go-live validation when engineering-level expertise is required.

System Deployment & Engineering Quality

  • Ensure new systems are installed, configured, and commissioned according to engineering requirements.
  • Validate installations performed by country Service teams and correct technical gaps where needed.
  • Ensure stable, secure communication between on-farm devices, gateways, and cloud platforms.
  • Oversee system testing, performance verification, and technical acceptance at critical sites.

Regional Standards & Compliance

  • Develop and maintain regional standards for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and network design.
  • Train and guide country Service teams to ensure consistent implementation of standards.
  • Conduct technical audits and reviews to verify compliance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Maintain engineering documentation, procedures, checklists, and training materials.

Solution Design & Sales Engineering Support

  • Support Sales and quotation teams with technical feasibility assessments and solution design, especially for non-standard or custom configurations.
  • Recommend system architectures, network designs, and equipment configurations tailored to unique farm layouts or operational needs.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, deployable, and aligned with long-term system reliability.
  • Clarify technical assumptions and engineering scope for Sales during pre-sales and proposal development.

Product Improvement & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Gather structured feedback from farmers, country Service teams, and Sales to identify product issues or enhancement opportunities.
  • Participate in testing and validating new firmware, software, or hardware updates before regional rollout.
  • Share recurring issues and regional technical insights with Global/Asia Engineering and suppliers.
  • Facilitate cross-country knowledge transfer and best practice sharing.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, system integration, or product engineering roles.
  • Experience with agricultural technology, industrial automation, or IoT systems preferred.
  • Regional or multi-country support experience is an advantage.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong expertise in troubleshooting complex hardware–software systems and IoT devices.
  • Proficiency in farm network infrastructure, including LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, gateways, and connectivity optimisation.
  • Ability to design and validate network architecture for large or challenging farm environments.
  • Hands-on experience with sensors, controllers, gateways, and farm management platforms.
  • Understanding of cloud-based systems, data communication, and device-to-cloud integrations.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Willingness to travel to farms and country offices for support, audits, and training.
  • Ability to work in challenging field environments and adapt solutions to real farm conditions.
  • Carry out any other duties as and when instructed by Management.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive business development strategies that focus on expanding market reach, strengthening brand presence, and driving substantial revenue growth in the field of drone and robotics solutions by identifying innovative approaches and leveraging emerging industry trends.

job.title: Senior Financial Controller
job.description:
Job Title: Senior Financial Controller
Job Location: Ayutthaya
Industry: International Manufacturing Company


Job Summary:
The Senior Financial Controller will lead the group’s financial operations and reporting of the manufacturing sites. This role oversees multi-site accounting teams, ensures strict compliance with international financial standards, and manages cross-border cash flows, tax planning, and internal controls.

Global Financial Reporting & Compliance

  • Direct the preparation of accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidated financial statements under USGAAP, THAI GAAP, IFRS, and SOX Compliance.
  • Oversee multi-currency accounting operations across various international subsidiaries.
  • Ensure full compliance with local and international tax laws, transfer pricing regulations, and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Manage annual global external audits and coordinate with external tax advisors and regulatory bodies.

Manufacturing Finance & Cost Control

  • Monitor global manufacturing costs, standard costing models, bill of materials (BOM), and variance analyses.
  • Track inventory valuations, supply chain costs, and capital expenditures across international production plants.

job.title: Technical Engineer
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Technical Engineer. This opportunity is based in Penang, Malaysia.

Position Overview

The Technical Engineer will provide customer-facing technical and application support across Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore, converting customer requirements into technically qualified opportunities. The role serves as a key link between customers, the regional commercial team and R&D, directly shaping product recommendations and supporting the organisation's technical growth in the region.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Technical & Application Support

  • Conduct customer technical discovery through meetings, technical visits, process reviews, CTQ collection, application requirement mapping and issue clarification.
  • Understand customer processes and translate application requirements into suitable product recommendations and technical next steps.
  • Support Sales and Business Development on qualified opportunities through technical discussions, product selection and customer evaluations.
  • Provide technical support during customer trials, first-use manufacturing and product qualification activities.
  • Build effective working relationships with customer engineering, process, quality and technical teams.

Application Testing & Qualification

  • Coordinate sample requests, trial preparation and customer evaluation follow-up.
  • Conduct or coordinate application screening activities including sample preparation, handling observations, cure evaluation, adhesion checks, pot life/work life assessment and process compatibility review.
  • Summarise trial results, observations, risks and recommended next actions in a clear and structured manner.
  • Coordinate with the Technical Manager, QC, R&D or Lab for advanced testing, failure analysis, formulation questions, reliability requirements or special customer requests.
  • Maintain proper test records, sample traceability and technical documentation in accordance with ISO 9001 and internal quality procedures.

Technical Project Management

  • Track strategic and qualified technical projects including customer requirements, project stage, technical barriers, next milestones and support required.
  • Ensure timely follow-up from initial inquiry through recommendation, sample evaluation, qualification and first commercial use.
  • Work closely with Sales and Business Development to improve sample-to-trial and trial-to-first-purchase conversion.
  • Provide structured project updates and highlight technical risks or resource requirements to the Technical Manager.

R&D & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain regular communication with the Technical Manager and R&D team on customer findings, application trends, technical gaps and emerging technology requirements.
  • Share Voice of Customer (VOC) and market/application insights that may support product development and application roadmap planning.
  • Work closely with QC on product quality questions, specifications, COA matters, complaint information and abnormal test findings.
  • Coordinate with Operations and Supply Chain on sample availability, packaging, lead time, handling requirements and trial readiness.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on technically accurate application materials, case studies, technical tips, seminar presentations and application diagrams when required.

Technical Knowledge & Market Development

  • Develop clear technical reports, application notes, case summaries, diagrams and internal knowledge records.
  • Support technical seminars, customer presentations and regional technical sharing activities.
  • Develop understanding of emerging applications and technologies in areas such as semiconductor packaging, electronic assembly, optoelectronics, CPO/NPO, thermal management and related electronics applications.
  • Gather customer and market technical information and communicate relevant findings internally.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Polymer Science, Material Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline is preferred.
  • Candidates with Mechanical or Electronics Engineering backgrounds may also be considered with relevant materials, process or application experience.
  • 1–3 years of experience in technical service, application engineering, process engineering, adhesives, coatings, electronic materials, semiconductor or industrial materials is preferred.
  • Fresh graduates with a strong polymer, chemistry or material science background may be considered if they demonstrate strong learning ability, hands-on discipline and communication maturity.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Ability to understand customer application requirements and translate them into practical product recommendations, screening plans and trial actions.
  • Ability to distinguish between confirmed data, assumptions, technical risks and recommended next steps.
  • Competent in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint for technical reports, data summaries and presentations.
  • Experience with epoxy, silicone or other adhesive/material applications would be advantageous.
  • Hands-on laboratory or manufacturing process experience involving sample preparation, material testing, data recording, failure observation or customer trial support would be advantageous.
  • Knowledge or experience in semiconductor packaging, electronic assembly, optoelectronics, thermal management or related electronics applications would be an advantage.
  • Willing to travel within Southeast Asia for customer visits, line trials, seminars and technical support activities.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with a hands-on technical mindset.
  • Strong ownership and disciplined project follow-up.
  • Good communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact effectively with customers and internal teams.
  • Self-motivated, open-minded and willing to learn new technologies and applications.
  • Ability to work independently while knowing when technical escalation is required.
  • Strong teamwork and cross-functional collaboration with Sales, BD, QC, R&D, Marketing and Operations.
  • Good command of English, with additional Southeast Asian language capability considered an advantage.

job.title: Managing Director Indonesia
job.description:
Managing Director – Indonesia

Location: South Jakarta, Indonesia
Industry: FMCG
Level: Executive
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Opportunity

Monroe is representing a European FMCG company with an established presence in Indonesia and a strong track record of business performance.

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Leader to lead the overall business and organization, with responsibility for driving sustainable growth, strengthening commercial execution, and developing a high-performing leadership team.

This is a highly visible leadership role, working closely with regional stakeholders and leading the Indonesia business across key commercial and corporate functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the overall Indonesia business, with accountability for commercial performance, organizational development, and business growth.
  • Own and manage the P&L, driving both topline growth and bottom-line performance.
  • Develop and execute the Indonesia business strategy in alignment with regional and global objectives.
  • Drive Sales and Marketing effectiveness, ensuring strong alignment between brand strategy, commercial priorities, and market execution.
  • Lead the development and execution of go-to-market strategies across relevant channels and customer segments.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen market presence, accelerate growth, and improve business performance.
  • Lead, motivate, challenge, and develop the leadership team to deliver against ambitious business objectives.
  • Foster a collaborative and high-performing organizational culture while maintaining strong employee engagement.
  • Work closely with regional and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, share best practices, and support broader business initiatives.
  • Ensure effective collaboration across functions including Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial Excellence, and other relevant areas.
  • Represent the Indonesia business at senior regional and organizational forums.
  • Provide clear strategic direction while maintaining strong execution discipline across the organization.

Key Requirements

  • 15+ years of relevant FMCG experience, with significant exposure to the Indonesian market.
  • Proven experience in a senior commercial leadership or general management position.
  • Strong leadership experience spanning both Sales and Marketing. Candidates with experience exclusively in one commercial function may not be suitable.
  • Demonstrated P&L management experience, with ownership of both topline and bottom-line results.
  • Strong understanding of the Indonesian consumer, retail, and go-to-market landscape.
  • Proven track record of driving business growth and leading organizational transformation or significant business initiatives.
  • Strong ability to translate strategy into commercial execution and measurable business results.
  • Experience managing and developing senior leadership teams.
  • Strong regional and cross-functional stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Excellent strategic, commercial, and decision-making skills.
  • Mature, collaborative, and people-oriented leadership style.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a regional environment.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with a genuine people-development mindset.

We are looking for a leader who can set high expectations while remaining approachable, collaborative, and supportive of the organization. The ability to balance people, performance, and long-term business development will be important.

The ideal candidate will bring the maturity to make sound business decisions, challenge the organization constructively, and build strong relationships across functions and geographies.

job.title: UX Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Information Technology sector to hire a UX Manager. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead the UX function and drive user-centred design practices across digital products, ensuring exceptional user experiences and design excellence.

Oversee the evolution and governance of the organisation's Design System to deliver consistency, scalability, accessibility, and efficiency across platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor UX designers, fostering a high-performance and collaborative design culture.
  • Manage UX resources, priorities, and project delivery across multiple initiatives.
  • Oversee UX projects from discovery, research, wireframing, prototyping, testing, and validation through delivery.
  • Ensure design quality, accessibility, implementation consistency, and adherence to UX and Design System standards across products.
  • Drive user research, usability testing, and data-informed design improvements.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to prioritise and deliver customer-focused solutions.
  • Own and govern the Design System, including standards, components, design tokens, accessibility, documentation, and adoption.
  • Define and manage the Design System roadmap to improve scalability, efficiency, and cross-platform consistency.
  • Establish governance, review, and quality assurance processes for UX and Design System adoption across products.
  • Define UX standards and acceptance criteria for accessibility, responsive behaviour, content handling, and Design System implementation quality.
  • Lead design reviews and facilitate alignment across UX, business, product, technology, and stakeholder groups.
  • Ensure Design System decisions, standards, and implementation guidance are documented, communicated, and traceable across teams.
  • Drive Design System adoption through documentation, training, stakeholder engagement, and knowledge sharing.
  • Continuously improve UX practices, Design System adoption, and delivery effectiveness.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing UX/UI teams.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Digital Experience Design.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, UX thinking, research, and design leadership.
  • Proven experience establishing, maintaining, or governing a Design System, including design tokens, component libraries, accessibility standards, and documentation.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong knowledge of user-centred design methodologies, Design Thinking, information architecture, interaction design, usability testing, and accessibility.
  • Expertise in Design System governance, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience defining and implementing design standards, governance processes, and quality assurance frameworks.
  • Proficiency in Figma, FigJam, AI-assisted design tools, prototyping tools, and design collaboration platforms.
  • Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility compliance, content handling, and scalable design processes.
  • Experience balancing user requirements, business objectives, technical constraints, and regulatory considerations across digital products.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership and team development capabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence decision-making across business, product, and technology stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on design quality and user experience excellence.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives within fast-paced environments.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for design innovation and user advocacy.

job.title: Senior Manager, Merchandising & Product Sourcing
job.description:
Executive Recruitment Consultant Monroe Consulting Group is working with a leading international home improvement and general merchandise retailer, with an established presence in Indonesia and a broad product assortment covering home improvement, household, lifestyle, hardware, and general merchandise products.

As part of its continued business growth, the company is looking to appoint a Senior Manager Merchandising & Product Sourcing to lead strategic product sourcing, product development, and assortment development for the Indonesian market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead strategic product sourcing and product development initiatives based on Indonesian consumer needs, market trends, and business opportunities.
  • Identify assortment gaps, emerging trends, new product opportunities, and potential categories relevant to the Indonesian market.
  • Translate consumer and market insights into commercially viable product and assortment recommendations.
  • Manage the end-to-end product development process, from product ideation and sourcing through supplier engagement, evaluation, and commercialization.
  • Work closely with international sourcing teams and suppliers/manufacturers in China to identify and develop relevant products for the Indonesian market.
  • Identify, evaluate, and develop relationships with strategic suppliers and manufacturers.
  • Collaborate with suppliers on product specifications, quality, costing, pricing, lead time, and product development requirements.
  • Conduct market, competitor, and category analysis to ensure the assortment remains relevant, differentiated, and commercially competitive.
  • Evaluate product opportunities based on consumer relevance, sales potential, pricing, margin, and overall category strategy.
  • Partner with the local merchandising team to translate product sourcing opportunities into the appropriate local assortment and category strategy.
  • Drive category and assortment development initiatives to improve product productivity, differentiation, competitiveness, and commercial performance.
  • Lead negotiations with suppliers and business partners to achieve optimal commercial terms.
  • Manage and influence stakeholders across local commercial teams, international teams, sourcing offices, and external suppliers.
  • Present product, sourcing, category, and assortment recommendations to senior management.

 

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in product sourcing, product development, merchandising, buying, category development, or related functions.
  • Strong track record in product sourcing, product development, and supplier/vendor management.
  • Experience in home improvement, household, hardware, hardgoods, general merchandise, lifestyle, or consumer products is highly preferred.
  • Experience working within an international buying office, global sourcing organization, multinational retailer, or consumer product business is highly advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of consumer trends, market insights, assortment development, and commercial evaluation.
  • Proven experience managing suppliers/manufacturers, particularly those based in China or other international sourcing markets.
  • Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of costing, pricing, margin, and product profitability.
  • Excellent negotiation, analytical, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Mandarin proficiency is highly preferred.
  • Comfortable working independently and driving initiatives in a newly established role.
  • Willingness to travel internationally when required.

job.title: Technical Head
job.description:
Technical Head - Elevators

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Technical Head - Elevators. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead and oversee the Installation, Commissioning, and Maintenance of home lifts across multiple regions.
Drive technical excellence, operational performance, customer satisfaction, and business growth through strategic leadership of the technical function.

Key Responsibilities

Installation & Commissioning

  • Oversee end-to-end installation processes, ensuring timely project start, completion, and handover within defined SLAs.
  • Plan and allocate resources effectively across multiple projects and regions.
  • Monitor installation quality, safety, and compliance standards to meet global benchmarks.
  • Track and reduce variation Orders by improving accuracy in site readiness and coordination with the sales and project teams.
  • Ensure project efficiency and adherence to planned production timelines.

Maintenance & After-Sales

  • Manage the complete maintenance lifecycle – from routine visits and preventive checks to breakdown management and renewals.
  • Drive KPIs such as:
    • Maintenance Visits completed on time.
    • Callback ratio reduction through proactive servicing.
    • Repair Order closure time and customer satisfaction index.
    • AMC Renewals and % price increase implementation year-on-year.
  • Ensure all service operations align with the company's customer delight framework.

Team & Operations Leadership

  • Lead the technical workforce including engineers, supervisors, and field executives.
  • Build leadership depth within regional teams through mentoring, performance management, and structured capability development.
  • Drive efficiency, accountability, and productivity through data-driven performance tracking and reporting.
  • Ensure Active PF compliance and field productivity monitoring across all regions.
  • Standardise technical processes and enforce adherence to SOPs across the network.

Financial & Strategic Management

  • Drive cost optimisation without compromising on quality, safety, or delivery standards.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Operations, and Supply Chain to streamline project cash flows and cost structures.
  • Track and improve collections from service contracts and renewal revenue contribution.

Customer Experience & Quality

  • Serve as a key stakeholder in driving post-sales excellence, ensuring zero escalations and maximum customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain strong coordination with CRM and Sales teams for smooth communication during installation and service stages.
  • Collect, monitor, and act on customer feedback, testimonials, and referrals to measure customer delight.
  • Drive initiatives that enhance brand reputation through quality performance and service reliability.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • 15–20 years of experience in Technical Operations / Installation / Service / Maintenance, preferably in Elevators & Lifts.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale, multi-location technical teams (200–300 members).
  • Degree qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering.
  • MBA preferred for senior management roles.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong understanding of installation planning, service operations, and field resource management.
  • Ability to oversee Installation, Commissioning, and Maintenance operations across multiple regions.
  • Experience driving maintenance KPIs, repair order closure, customer satisfaction metrics, AMC renewals, and service performance.
  • Experience in technical process standardisation and SOP implementation.
  • Strong capability in cost optimisation, project delivery, operational planning, and service contract management.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, CRM, and Sales functions.
  • Experience managing engineers, supervisors, and field executives across regional operations.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Excellent leadership, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to drive a performance-based culture and align team objectives with business goals.
  • Strong mentoring and capability development skills.
  • Ability to build leadership depth within regional teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence and continuous improvement.

job.title: Senior Operations Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Logistics sector to hire a Senior Operations Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.

Position Overview
The role leads and manages the 4PL Hub Operations Team to deliver high-quality logistics services. It plays a critical role in ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across regional supply chain operations.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team within the assigned 4PL Hub Operations Team.
  • Build and nurture a high-performing team culture that emphasises accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Empower team members by delegating responsibilities effectively, encouraging innovation, and recognising contributions.
  • Act as a role model for ethical leadership, promoting transparency, integrity, and compliance across all operations.
  • Develop succession planning and talent pipelines to ensure long-term organisational resilience.
  • Define team structure, roles, and responsibilities aligned with business goals and customer expectations.
  • Lead change management initiatives, guiding teams through organisational restructuring, digital transformation, and evolving customer demands.
  • Mentor and coach managers and team leaders, equipping them with the skills and confidence to manage complex logistics operations.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Manage escalations, performance issues, and ensure adequate coverage during holidays or absences.
  • Drive employee engagement and retention through coaching, recognition, and career development planning.
  • Operational Oversight & Execution
  • Oversee end-to-end logistics operations including planning, booking, and shipment monitoring to ensure seamless execution.
  • Ensure compliance with customer contracts, service level agreements (SLAs), and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Implement and enforce standardised processes across the team to ensure consistency and efficiency.
  • Monitor daily dashboards and proactively address deviations or bottlenecks in real-time.
  • Develop and implement strategies to optimise supply chain efficiency and resilience.
  • Quality, Compliance & Risk Management
  • Ensure all operations adhere to the company’s Quality Plan and risk management framework.
  • Oversee the logging, investigation, and resolution of customer complaints and non-conformities.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation of business processes and ensure audit readiness.
  • Customer Relationship Management
  • Act as the senior point of contact for key customers, ensuring high satisfaction and trust.
  • Lead regular customer reviews (weekly/bi-weekly/monthly), presenting performance insights, addressing concerns, and aligning improvement plans.
  • Manage special customer requests and escalations, ensuring timely resolution and communication.
  • Collaborate with IT and other departments to ensure customer systems and tools are functioning optimally.
  • Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement through regular process reviews and lean initiatives.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for automation, cost savings, and service enhancements.
  • Collaborate with supply chain engineers and cross-functional teams to optimise workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.
  • Lead initiatives such as morning briefings, performance huddles, and Kaizen events.
  • 3PL Logistics Provider Performance Management
  • Work closely with 3PL/Steering teams to evaluate and enhance LSP performance.
  • Lead or participate in 3PL review meetings, ensuring alignment on service levels and corrective actions.
  • Monitor and report on 3PL KPIs, escalating issues as needed and driving accountability.
  • Scope & Change Management
  • Identify operational impacts of scope changes and communicate them to leadership.
  • Support the integration of new customers, services, or geographies into the 4PL hub.
  • Ensure smooth transitions and minimal disruption during organisational or process changes.
  • Governance & Policy Adherence
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, including neutrality, ethics, and quality standards.
  • Represent the 4PL Hub Operations Team in audits, customer visits, and internal governance forums.
  • Reporting & Business Intelligence
  • Provide regular reports on 3PL performance, quality, finance, and productivity.
  • Analyse root causes for escalations and propose corrective actions.
  • Monitor Incoterm location files and resolve discrepancies.

Key Requirements


  • Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years in transport or freight forwarding.

  • 5+ years in customer service with international clients.

  • Experience in 4PL or Control Tower environments preferred.

  • Team management experience of over 50 staff is essential.

  • Background in logistics, supply chain, or international trade.

  • Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong leadership and customer service skills.

  • Excellent communication in English (additional languages a plus).

  • Proficiency in MS Office and logistics tools.

  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

  • Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills.

  • Organised, responsive, and detail-oriented.

  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ethical leadership, transparency, and integrity.

  • Ability to foster collaboration and continuous learning.

job.title: Service & Sales Engineer (Mechanical & Electrical)
job.description:
Service & Sales Engineer (Mechanical & Electrical)

Introduction
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a well-established organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Service & Sales Engineer (Mechanical & Electrical). This opportunity is based in Selangor, Malaysia.
Position Overview
This role is responsible for delivering technical service, installation, and maintenance support for mechanical and electrical equipment systems at customer farm sites, while identifying opportunities for spare parts and service sales. It plays a key part in ensuring equipment reliability, customer satisfaction, and long-term account growth for the organisation.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Service & Support (Mechanical & Electrical)
  • Perform installation, testing, service, and commissioning of BD equipment systems.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve mechanical and electrical faults at the farm sites.
  • Conduct electrical fault finding and troubleshooting for control circuits, sensors, actuators, motors, and power systems.
  • Inspect wiring, grounding, and power distribution to identify and rectify hazards or inefficiencies.
  • Carry out loop checks, insulation resistance testing, and continuity testing
  • Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance to ensure equipment reliability and compliance with safety standards.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of system technologies and provide technical guidance to customers.
  • Maintain accurate service reports, checklist and maintenance history for each customer
Collaborative Problem Solving
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Tech teams to anticipate and resolve complex customer challenges before they escalate
Spare Parts Sales & Maintenance
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities via service visits and promote relevant spare parts, upgrades, or service maintenance contracts.
  • Provide technical advice and sales support in upselling of sub-system, promote appropriate solutions for farm maintenance and propose cost-effective replacements or upgrades based on diagnostic reports and lifecycle data
Project & Site Coordination
  • Work closely with project engineers, site supervisors, and contractors during installation and deployment phases.
  • Ensure project timelines are met, and installation quality standards are upheld.
  • Manage changes and variation orders in technical specifications
Customer Training and Support
  • Conduct on-site training for farm operators on equipment use, safety, and maintenance.
  • Prepare and submit service reports, checklists, and feedback after each visit.
  • Provide recommendations to improve system performance and farm efficiency to the customer.
  • Support onboarding and usability: Ensure farmers are onboarded effectively understanding BD systems (from trainings) and anticipating any potential challenges and addressing them before they arise
  • Anticipate Customer Needs: Regularly check in with farmers to proactively identify issues, suggest improvements, and ensure the technology is delivering optimal value.
  • Feedback Loop & Product Advocacy: Actively gather customer feedback to anticipate future needs and inform product development, ensuring the solution evolves to meet farmers' changing challenges.
Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
  • Degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Automation Engineering.
  • Minimum 2–5 years' experience in field service, technical sales, or equipment installation, preferably in agriculture or livestock equipment.
Technical / Functional Expertise
  • Hands-on knowledge in mechanical assemblies and electrical control panels.
  • Strong knowledge of Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), and network communication protocols (e.g., LAN, IP configuration).
  • Experience in automation systems and industrial networking will be an added advantage.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering and wiring diagrams.
  • Familiarity with poultry farming operations is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in MS Office.
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
  • Customer service mindset with good interpersonal communication.
  • Willingness to travel (domestic & overseas) to farm or project sites as per project duration.
  • Willingness to work on weekends and public holidays as per project duration.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with specialist physicians, ensuring effective engagement, communication, and alignment with hospital objectives.
  • Monitor and improve the performance, utilization, and quality of medical services across the hospital.

job.title: Head of HR
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an executive search firm's Consumer Division is partnering with a global manufacturer to hire a strategic and experienced Head of HR in Malaysia to build and lead the Human Resources function as the business continues to grow.

The role will be responsible for designing the HR strategy, establishing scalable HR processes and policies, building the organizational structure, strengthening leadership capability and creating a performance-driven culture across the Malaysia business.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement the overall HR strategy for Malaysia, aligned with the company's business plans and growth objectives.
  • Build the HR function, framework and governance structure to support a rapidly scaling organization.
  • Design and establish HR policies, processes, SOPs and guidelines across the complete employee lifecycle.
  • Develop the appropriate organization structure, manpower plan and workforce strategy in line with business expansion.
  • Establish a structured performance management framework, including KRAs, KPIs, goal setting, performance reviews and performance improvement processes.
  • Develop leadership development initiatives and strengthen the organization's management capability.
  • Establish a structured career progression, promotion and internal mobility framework.
  • Partner with the leadership team on organization design, restructuring and change management initiatives.
  • Develop a strategic talent acquisition framework covering leadership, managerial, sales, technical and support functions. Establish manpower planning and recruitment processes that can support rapid business expansion.
  • Create HR dashboards and people analytics/MIS to provide leadership with insights on headcount, attrition, hiring, performance and productivity.
  • Establish a strong HR governance framework covering policies, compliance, employee relations and people processes.
  • Ensure HR policies and processes are aligned with Malaysian employment laws and statutory requirements.
  • Build an effective HR team with clear roles, responsibilities, KPIs and operating processes.
  • Work closely with Business, Finance and Operations leaders to identify organizational and people challenges and develop solutions.
  • Drive the adoption of HR technology / HRMS and digitize key HR processes wherever appropriate.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Country Head and senior leadership team on organization, people and culture matters.

Job Requirements:

  • 12–18 years of HR experience, with significant experience in a strategic HR leadership role.
  • Current or previous experience as Head HR / HR Director / Senior HRBP / HR Leader.
  • Strong experience in building, setting up or transforming HR processes and frameworks.
  • Experience working with senior leadership and translating business requirements into HR strategy.
  • Strong exposure to organization design, workforce planning and performance management.
  • Experience establishing HR policies, SOPs, processes and governance frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of Malaysia employment legislation and HR practices.
  • Experience in a growing, scaling or transformation-focused organization is highly preferred.
  • Exposure to manufacturing, engineering, D2C, retail, service or other sales-driven businesses would be an advantage.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect people strategy with business performance.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills.

job.title: Regional Treasury Manager (Regional Treasurer)
job.description:
Position Overview
The Regional Treasury Manager will take full ownership of regional cash management, liquidity optimization, banking operations, and treasury governance across multiple entities in the region. The role will be responsible for driving efficient cash utilization, managing cross-border cash flows, supporting banking relationships, and ensuring compliance with treasury policies and local regulations. 
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead regional cash forecasting, liquidity planning, and cash flow optimization across multiple countries.
  • Execute and streamline intercompany funding, dividend repatriation, and cross-border cash movements while minimizing FX exposure and transactional costs.
  • Manage and optimize cash pooling and Zero Balance Account (ZBA) structures across the region.
  • Oversee banking operations, including bank account administration, KYC requirements, signatory management, and banking relationship management.
  • Negotiate banking fees, FX spreads, and treasury-related service costs.
  • Deliver accurate treasury, liquidity, and cash reporting to senior leadership, including the Regional CFO and Group Treasurer.
  • Ensure compliance with treasury policies, local banking regulations, capital controls, transfer pricing requirements, and other regulatory obligations.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Tax, Controlling, and business stakeholders to support funding requirements and strategic initiatives. 
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 7-10 years of corporate treasury experience within an MNC or regional headquarters environment.
  • Strong expertise in cash management, liquidity planning, banking operations, and treasury controls.
  • Experience managing multi-country treasury activities, intercompany funding, and cross-border transactions.
  • Good knowledge of Treasury Management Systems (TMS), ERP platforms such as SAP or Oracle, and electronic banking portals.
  • Solid understanding of regional banking regulations, capital controls, transfer pricing considerations, and withholding tax implications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to operate independently in a highly visible regional role.

job.title: Story Specialist
job.description:
Who We Are 

International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable. 

 

We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve.   

 

 

The Need 

For 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence by 2030, we are seeking a Survivor Leadership Specialist to provide strategic direction and implement the growth of national survivor networks—ensuring alignment with IJM’s Protection Model and the Global Survivor Network (GSN). The role will also engage with government agencies, NGOs, and survivor-led movements to increase victim protection, expand safe and ethical survivor participation, and build safe reporting channels and inclusive platforms for advocacy 

 

 

This position is based in Bangkok, Thailand and reports to Social Services Manager and is only available for candidates with the right to work in Thailand. Candidates should be based in Thailand and proficient in English and Thai. 

 

 

Responsibilities 

 

  1. Development, implementation, and continuous improvement of survivor leadership and survivor network strategies, ensuring programs are trauma-informed, aligned with IJM Global standards, and responsive to IJM’s project goals and Protection Model; 

  1. Provide technical leadership and support to emerging and existing survivor networks, including identification and development of survivor leaders, and the creation of safe, inclusive physical and virtual spaces for survivors to organize, advocate, and lead initiatives; 

  1. Design and delivery of capacity development (training, coaching, mentoring and support) for survivor network members, enabling survivor leaders to engage effectively in advocacy and provide survivor-informed recommendations, including through trauma-informed practice, ethical storytelling, and survivor-led advocacy; 

 

 

Strategy & Program Implementation   

  1. Mentor and equip survivor leaders to engage as credible, ethical, and effective voices in advocating for protection; 

  1. Lead the design and implementation of survivor leadership strategies that strengthen local survivor networks and build advocacy capacity related to forced labor, labor trafficking, and labor exploitation; 

  1. Ensure trauma-informed and participatory approaches in program design and implementation; 

  1. Conduct risk assessments and oversee and safeguarding measures to ensure survivor safety in advocacy, media, and public engagement;  

  1. Empower survivors to initiate and implement survivor leadership initiatives that contribute to protection, prevention and systems change; 

  1. Provide or coordinate coaching and mentoring support to survivor network members.  

 

  

Survivor Networking & Advocate Development 

  1. Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to provide technical support for survivor network growth and sustainability; 

  1. Identify and support survivor leaders, ensuring inclusive representation across gender, nationality, exploitation type, and geography, expanding group members to scale impact; 

  1. Conduct survivor network capacity development training;   

  1. Facilitate safe meeting spaces and structured pathways for survivor-led initiatives and advocacy;  

  1. Co-develop virtual survivor networks, particularly in newer forms of exploitation such as forced scamming;   

  1. Support survivor networks to implement community‑level protection and awareness activities, contributing to increased reliance and protection.  

  

Communication 

  1. Provide survivor‑informed input into advocacy messaging, ethical storytelling, and communications that contribute to policy improvement, increased victim protection, and justice system performance.  

  

Training and Capacity Development 

  1. Ensure timely delivery of survivor leadership training, including public speaking, advocacy, and media engagement.   

  1. Identify and coordinate capacity‑building resources to support survivor leaders’ advocacy and engagement.  

  1. Ensure survivor leaders have access to psychosocial support, stress management, and well‑being resources.   

  1. Develop or adapt training tools on trauma‑informed practice, survivor‑led advocacy, safeguarding, and ethical public engagement.   

  

Research, Program Management and M&E 

  1. Work with Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL) staff to integrate survivor consultation and leadership into monitoring, evaluation, research and learning; 

  1. Support research and learning initiatives related to survivor leadership, advocacy, and participation  

 

Documentation, Reporting & Data Management  

  1. Maintain survivor network tracking, monitor participation and growth, and document learning and best practices; 

  1. Ensure the documentation of key training activities and advocacy initiatives; 

  1. Develop, monitor, and manage survivor leadership budget and expenses in coordination with department leadership.  

  

 

Qualifications:  

  • Master's degree in social work preferred, or Bachelors’ degree with equivalent professional experience; 

  • Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in survivor services, social work, human rights, or related NGO/CSO contexts; 

  • Demonstrated experience supporting survivor leadership, networks, or movements; 

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience coaching and mentoring; 

  • Experience in coaching, mentoring, or facilitating adult learning, preferably with survivors or community leaders; 

  • Understanding of government systems and processes related to forced labor, human trafficking, and labor exploitation; 

  • Demonstrated experience supporting formation and development of networks of survivors or similar groups; 

  • Demonstrated expertise in assessing and developing capacity of professionals in trauma-informed approaches or other relevant skills.  

  

Critical Qualities:   

  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills;  

  • Excellent planning and implementing skills; 

  • Deep familiarity with trauma‑informed and survivor‑centered approaches; 

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills;  

  • Fluency in oral and written English and Thai; 

  • Leadership in mentoring, coaching, consulting, and training skills;  

  • International/cross-cultural experience in development, relief, social work, or other fields; 

  • Relationship‑building and networking; 

  • Facilitation and coordination; 

  • Sound judgment and ethical decision making; 

  • Effective team player; 

  • Humble, service-oriented attitude; 

  • Highest integrity and honesty; 

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information; 

  • Strong interpersonal skills; 

  • Professional, diplomatic, and mature demeanor.

job.title: Senior Merchandising Manager
job.description:
Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute merchandising strategies aligned with company goals.
  • Manage product assortment, category planning, and SKU rationalization.

job.title: Warehouse and Materials Operations Manager
job.description:
Position Title: Warehouse & Materials Operations Manager

Department: Supply Chain & Logistics Operations

Location: Ayutthaya Plant, Thailand

Base Salary Range: 100,000 – 120,000 THB / Month

Position Summary

The Warehouse & Materials Operations Manager plans, directs, and optimizes all warehouse and internal material handling activities supporting the site's Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) operations. This position ensures pristine inventory accuracy, seamless material feeds to active production lines, full quality/regulatory compliance, and ongoing operational productivity.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

1. Operational Execution & Shopfloor Support


  • Oversee all core warehouse activities: Receiving, Main Store, Indirect/MRO Store, Finished Goods, and Shipping.

  • Guarantee uninterrupted material supply to SMT, mechanical assembly, testing, and packaging operations.

  • Optimize floor layouts, storage density, and material traffic paths to elevate productivity and space usage.

  • Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manage security control systems across all storage zones.

2. Inventory Control & Integrity


  • Drive inventory accuracy across all stock categories through structured cycle counting and annual physical stock counts.

  • Enforce strict FIFO/FEFO material movement principles across raw materials and sub-assemblies.

  • Conduct root-cause analyses on stock variances, implementing corrective actions to prevent recurring gaps.

  • Monitor inventory velocity to eliminate material shortages, excess stock, and obsolete inventory.

3. Shipping, Logistics & Cross-Functional Alignment


  • Manage domestic and international freight forwarders to guarantee on-time outbound shipments to global clients.

  • Verify shipping documentation accuracy, export/import compliance, and customer-specific labeling needs.

  • Collaborate closely with Planning, Purchasing, Quality, and Production teams to manage Material Review Board (MRB), Return to Vendor (RTV), and Customer Material Authorization (CMA) workflows.

4. Quality, ESD & Regulatory Compliance


  • Ensure strict operational compliance with Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) handling standards for sensitive components.

  • Maintain audit readiness for ISO 9001, ISO 13485, IPC, customer-specific, and internal EHS safety standards.

5. Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership


  • Lead, coach, and develop warehouse supervisors and floor operators; conduct performance evaluations and manage labor capacity planning.

  • Champion Lean manufacturing practices, 5S, Kaizen, and warehouse automation/digitalization projects to reduce operational overhead.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


  • Inventory Accuracy Rate (%) & Cycle Count Accuracy (%)

  • On-Time Material Delivery to Production (%)

  • On-Time Outbound Shipment Performance (%)

  • Warehouse Productivity (Transactions / Headcount)

  • Warehouse Space Utilization (%)

  • Safety & EHS Compliance Score

Qualifications & Skill Profile


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.

  • Work Experience: 7+ years in warehouse/logistics operations, including 3–5 years in a supervisory or management capacity. EMS or electronics assembly background strongly preferred.

  • Systems Expertise: Advanced user of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or Dynamics) and WMS tools; proficient in MS Excel and data analytics.

  • Core Competencies: Strong team leadership, root-cause problem solving, knowledge of Lean/Six Sigma principles, and fluently spoken/written English for corporate reporting.

job.description:
Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Key Responsibilities

Treasury & Liquidity Management

  • Manage cash flow, liquidity, banking facilities, and debt obligations across the company and its subsidiaries.

Internal Control, Risk Management & Corporate Governance

  • Develop and strengthen internal control systems, enterprise risk management, and corporate governance practices in accordance with listed company standards.
  • Regularly assess and manage financial risks across the group.
  • Oversee quarterly reviews, statutory audits, and coordinate with the Audit Committee, Internal Audit, and external auditors.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including the Securities and Exchange Act, Public Limited Companies Act, SEC regulations, and SET requirements.
  • Oversee accurate, complete, and timely disclosure of information to the SET, including insider trading controls and blackout period compliance.
  • Perform duties as a designated executive under SEC regulations, including securities holding reports (Form 59) as required.

Stakeholder & Investor Relations

  • Maintain strong relationships with investors, financial analysts, financial institutions, auditors, the SET, SEC, and other regulatory authorities.
  • Represent the company at investor relations events, including Opportunity Day, analyst meetings, and roadshows.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and manage the Finance and Accounting organization.
  • Develop and strengthen the capabilities of the finance team to meet best-in-class organizational standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in finance and/or accounting, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive role.
  • Meet the qualification requirements of the SEC Thailand for the highest-ranking finance/accounting executive (CFO) of a listed company, including:
    • Relevant accounting or finance experience as prescribed by SEC regulations.
    • Completion of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) training in accounting (minimum six hours annually).
    • No disqualifying characteristics under SEC regulations.
  • Proven experience working with companies listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand, with strong knowledge of:
    • SEC and SET regulations
    • Public Limited Companies Act
    • Thai Civil and Commercial Code relating to corporate governance
  • Strong knowledge of financial regulations, taxation, financial reporting requirements, and compliance frameworks.
  • Professional certifications such as CPA or CFA, together with CPD qualifications, will be an advantage.
  • Solid experience in budgeting, financial planning, and forecasting.
  • Excellent analytical skills with strong business acumen.

  • Good command of both written and spoken English.
