job.title: Senior Customer Service [Order Management]
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Healthcare industry to hire a Senior Order Fulfilment Executive. This opportunity is based in Malaysia and offers the chance to lead customer service operations while driving excellence across the order-to-cash process in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Position Overview

Lead and oversee customer service operations, ensuring seamless execution of the end-to-end order-to-cash process and exceptional customer support.
Drive operational excellence, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction and business performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. OTC Operations

  • Lead and oversee daily Customer Service operations, ensuring effective execution of the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process.
  • Maintain defined KPIs, including order accuracy, turnaround time, and service level adherence.

2. Order Management

  • Ensure accurate and timely processing of customer orders from order entry through to delivery fulfilment.
  • Oversee key order management activities, including pricing validation, order clearing, and preparation of shipping, invoicing, and Letter of Credit (LC) documentation in accordance with company policies.
  • Monitor and manage order backlog, proactively addressing potential delays and ensuring timely resolution.

3. Customer Experience & Issue Resolution

  • Manage customer escalations effectively, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Maintain proactive communication with customers on order status, delays, and mitigation plans to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.

4. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders such as BU Leaders, Sales, Finance, Accounting, Legal, and Supply Chain/Planning teams to ensure seamless order execution.
  • Liaise with global manufacturing sites and third-party vendors across the US, Europe, and APAC regions to meet delivery commitments and customer expectations.

5. Financial & Compliance Management

  • Partner with Finance and Accounting teams to manage credit-related matters, including Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) issues, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution.
  • Ensure all order processing activities and documentation are compliant with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.

6. Process Improvement & Reporting

  • Identify opportunities to improve systems, processes, and tools to enhance operational efficiency and accuracy.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and order management projects.
  • Prepare and review regular reports to track operational performance and support decision-making.

7. Additional Duties

  • Deliver training and presentations to relevant stakeholders on process updates and key initiatives.
  • Support ad-hoc tasks and projects as assigned.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Proven experience in order management and customer service roles.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong knowledge of end-to-end Order-to-Cash (OTC) operations.
  • Experience in customer order processing, order backlog management, pricing validation, and order clearing.
  • Knowledge of shipping, invoicing, and Letter of Credit (LC) documentation.
  • Experience managing customer escalations, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive actions.
  • Exposure to Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) processes.
  • Understanding of compliance, regulatory requirements, and audit standards related to order processing.
  • Experience driving process improvement and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office.
  • Project management skills.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and global stakeholders across US, Europe, and APAC regions.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across functions and influence key stakeholders.
  • Proactive mindset with a focus on operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

job.title: Free Trade Supervisor
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting on behalf of a leading manufacturing enterprise. We are seeking a high-caliber Free Zone & Trade Compliance Specialist to oversee daily Free Zone operations, guarantee 100% customs compliance, and optimize import-export workflows. Reporting directly to management, this role acts as the primary gatekeeper for asset movements, stock integrity, and statutory audit readiness across our Free Zone facility. The Free Zone & Trade Compliance Specialist is responsible for directing daily operational workflows within the Free Zone to ensure full compliance with customs legislation, accurate inventory tracking, and seamless Import–Export activities.
  • Direct and monitor all material movements into, within, and out of the Free Zone (raw materials, finished goods, machinery, and capital assets).
  • Perform thorough verification of Import–Export declarations, shipping documents, and customs clearance paperwork for zero errors.
  • Maintain HS Code classifications, duty exemption privileges, and tariff database integrity in system records.
  • Conduct periodic physical stock reconciliations against Free Zone system balances to ensure full asset accountability.
  • Investigate stock discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement preventive/corrective actions.
  • Compile and organize documentation for official Customs Audits, Revenue Department reviews, and Internal Audits.
  • Investigate stock discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement preventive/corrective actions.
  • Compile and organize documentation for official Customs Audits, Revenue Department reviews, and Internal Audits.
  • Act as the primary liaison with the Thai Customs Department, licensed Customs Brokers, Shipping Agents, and Freight Forwarders.
  • Author, review, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) regarding Free Zone compliance.
  • Assign tasks, monitor performance metrics, and mentor operational team members.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Document Accuracy: Zero discrepancies in customs documentation and regulatory filings.
  • Stock Precision: High accuracy rate between physical stock/assets and Free Zone ERP balances.
  • Audit Performance: Zero penalty findings or major non-conformities during Customs & Internal Audits.
  • Operational Flow: Timely clearance of inbound/outbound shipments without customs delays.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, International Business, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • Experienced in Free Zone management, customs clearance, or international trade compliance.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, analytical mindset for inventory data, and structured coordination skills.
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel) and operational proficiency in ERP (SAP/Oracle) and WMS platforms.
  • Professional English proficiency (written and spoken.

job.title: TA Manager
job.description:
Are you an ambitious, hands-on leader with a passion for growth and a startup mindset? Do you thrive in dynamic environments and possess the commercial acumen to drive significant expansion? 

 

One of Asia's most exciting, fast-growing lifestyle and consumer product startups is seeking a AMD - People Strategic partner to join its energetic and highly successful leadership team. This is a rare opportunity to step into a pivotal leadership role, acting as the strategic right hand to a truly exceptional CEO and MDs 

 

The Opportunity: A Force Multiplier 
 

The Assistant Managing Director (AMD) will function as a strategic force multiplier within the organization. This is a unique hybrid role that blends operational leadership with the critical functions of an HR Business Partner. 

 

  • You will be the essential bridge between the CEO's high-level strategic vision and the company's day-to-day operational engine. 

  • Your core mandate is twofold: to build a world-class team by leading talent acquisition, and to ensure the CEO's ambitious ideas are flawlessly translated into implemented, ground-level actions. 

  • Your success will be measured by the quality of the talent you bring in and your ability to drive execution and alignment across every level of the business. 

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Act as a Talent Architect: Spearhead the recruitment of A-tier talent across all functions, embedding yourself as a strategic HR Business Partner who understands that the right people are the ultimate competitive advantage. 

  • Be the Strategic-to-Operational Bridge: Masterfully interpret the CEO's directives, breaking down complex strategies into actionable plans and ensuring seamless communication and follow-through from leadership to the front lines. 

  • Become an Execution Powerhouse: Champion a culture of rapid implementation. Take ownership of key initiatives, drive projects to completion, and instill a standard of operational excellence throughout the organization. 
     

The Leader You Will Partner With 

You will report directly to a visionary Managing Director – an analytical, hands-on, and highly entrepreneurial leader. Our client's CEO has a true startup mindset: a data-driven engineer who leads by example, diving into everything from logistics and supply chain to cutting-edge digital marketing. He embodies a spirit of constant exploration and rapid implementation of new business trends. This is a leader who will challenge you, mentor you, and empower you to make a tangible impact. 
 

Qualifications: 

  • Proven experience in a leadership role within a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g., startup, scale-up, or a dynamic corporate venture). 

  • A demonstrated track record in talent acquisition and building high-performing teams. 

  • Exceptional operational acumen with the ability to manage complex projects and drive them to completion. 

  • A "player-coach" mentality—someone who can strategize and execute at the ground level. 

  • The emotional intelligence and communication skills to effectively influence both senior leaders and operational staff. 

  • An innate ability to thrive in ambiguity and a strong bias for action over deliberation.

job.title: Audit Director
job.description:
Executive search firm Monroe Consulting Group Philippines is recruiting on behalf of a company that is a Cebu-based Filipino holding company with over 60 years of history, with diversified investments in fashion retail, wood products, real estate, food retail, and primary healthcare. Our respective client is seeking for an Audit Director who will lead and strengthen the internal audit function of the organization. The role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to provide independent assurance on the effectiveness of governance, risk, and compliance processes and will cover audit, financial reporting, risk management, and internal controls. He role will be reporting to the VP of Finance with hybrid work arrangement in Mandaue City, Cebu.

Tasks and Responsibilities:
  • Lead and oversee internal audit activities to assess the effectiveness of internal controls, risk management practices, and compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Analyze financial performance, identify key trends and opportunities, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management to support informed strategic decision-making.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory requirements, and corporate governance policies, while proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating financial and operational risks.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including auditors, regulatory agencies, business leaders, and service providers, to ensure efficient and effective finance, accounting, and audit operations.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop finance, accounting, and audit teams, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and high performance.
  • Drive initiatives to strengthen internal controls, enhance financial and operational processes, improve efficiency, and support organizational growth. Lead or participate in special projects and other strategic initiatives as assigned by Management.
Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, must be CPA. Masters Degree in Accounting for Finance is preferred.
  • At least 5 years of audit experience preferably from a Big 4 or similarly recognized audit firm. 
  • Must possess strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial analysis tools, keen attention to detail.
  • Experience with ERPs, preferably SAP.
  • Must be an effective team leader with the ability to organize and execute when under demanding conditions and the demonstrated ability to manage stakeholders from all levels of the organization effectively. 
  • Must demonstrate strong and grounded analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively Integrity and Ethics.

job.title: Head of IT Operations and Infrastructure Management
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Information Technology sector to hire a Head of IT Operations & Infrastructure Management. This opportunity is based in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead the strategy, governance, and operational management of the organisation's IT infrastructure, ensuring secure, scalable, and highly available technology services.

Drive infrastructure modernisation, operational excellence, and technology resilience to support critical business operations and future growth.

Key Responsibilities

IT Infrastructure Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and execute the IT infrastructure roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Establish governance frameworks for IT operations, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Define and enforce best practices for infrastructure management, cloud computing, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
  • Drive infrastructure transformation initiatives to support organisational growth and digital enablement.

Network & Cloud Management

  • Oversee the design, implementation, and optimisation of enterprise network architecture.
  • Manage cloud infrastructure environments, ensuring scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of IT systems and services.
  • Lead data centre operations, including storage, backup, recovery, and business continuity capabilities.

IT Service Management & Operations

  • Implement IT service management best practices to support efficient and reliable operations.
  • Monitor infrastructure and system performance, identifying optimisation opportunities and operational improvements.
  • Ensure timely resolution of incidents and service disruptions while minimising business impact.
  • Lead technology change and release management activities to ensure smooth implementation of new solutions.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, service providers, and key partners.
  • Oversee procurement activities, contract management, and service level performance.
  • Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to ensure infrastructure services support organisational priorities.
  • Monitor vendor performance and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure and operations team.
  • Provide technical leadership across infrastructure architecture, cloud services, operations, and technology governance.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Support professional development and capability-building initiatives across the team.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, IT Operations, Cloud Services, or Technology Management roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale infrastructure environments and enterprise technology operations.
  • Strong experience managing technology vendors, commercial agreements, and outsourced service providers.
  • Demonstrated success delivering complex technology initiatives within business-critical environments.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong expertise in enterprise infrastructure management, network architecture, and cloud computing.
  • Experience managing data centres, backup and recovery solutions, and business continuity programmes.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL Server, database management, and enterprise infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience implementing IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks and operational governance practices.
  • Knowledge of ITIL, COBIT, ISO/IEC 20000, ISO 22301, ISO 31000, TOGAF, IT Asset Management (ITAM), and related governance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture best practices across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience managing infrastructure security, operational resilience, and risk management initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of network technologies, enterprise systems, and high-availability architectures.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking and decision-making abilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk management capabilities.
  • Ability to drive transformation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Proven capability to manage multiple priorities within fast-paced and complex environments.

job.title: Trade Partnerships Manager (BD Manager)
job.description:
Trade Partnerships Manager
 
  • Industry: Business Advisory / Trade & Market Access Solutions
  • Location: Bangkok, Thailand (Monday – Friday, Standard Business Hours)
  • Monthly Base Salary:
    • Manager Level: THB 55,000 – 80,000
    • Senior Manager Level: Up to THB 120,000 (commensurate with 5–8+ years of relevant experience)
  • Total Compensation Package: Basic Salary + 1-Month AWS + Performance Bonus
The Opportunity
Are you an accomplished partnership builder and strategic facilitator skilled in bridging international enterprises with local market ecosystems?
Our client is a premier Business Advisory organization dedicated to enabling cross-border commercial growth, international trade facilitation, and market entry strategy. We are seeking a high-caliber Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Manager to act as the primary catalyst for Asia-based enterprises establishing and scaling their commercial footprint in Thailand.
Note: This is not a direct sales, cold-calling, lead generation, or commission/target-driven commercial role. This strategic facilitation mandate is focused on high-level stakeholder engagement, public-private collaboration, and structuring meaningful, long-term partnerships from exploration through to successful implementation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Serve as the strategic bridge for the new companies across Asia expanding into Thailand, identifying collaboration opportunities and connecting them with credible local partners, joint ventures, and enterprise clients.
  • and maintain strong relationships with government agencies, trade bodies, chambers of commerce, and industry associations across Thailand and the region.
  • Map local industry ecosystems, understand multi-party commercial objectives, identify mutual strategic interests, and facilitate bilateral cooperation agreements.
  • Steer partnership initiatives from initial matchmaking and high-level stakeholder dialogue through to formal execution and practical project implementation.
  • Engage comfortably with C-suite executives, senior government officials, and key community leaders, delivering market insights and strategic alignment.
Key Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Relations, Economics, or related disciplines.
  • Professional Experience:

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm's Healthcare Division is partnering with a growing Pharmaceutical company to hire a Product Manager to be based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

The Product Manager will be responsible for overseeing the lifecycle of pharmaceutical products, from development to commercialization. This includes managing the product portfolio, strategic planning, market analysis, and working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, regulatory, and R&D teams. The role requires a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical market, strong project management skills, and the ability to drive product success in a competitive environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Planning:

  • Develop and implement product strategies in alignment with overall business goals.
  • Collaborate with senior management to define product positioning, market access strategies, and pricing strategies.
  • Monitor and analyze industry trends, competitor products, and regulatory developments to ensure product success and compliance.

Product Lifecycle Management:

  • Manage the product lifecycle from development to launch, ensuring products meet market needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with R&D and regulatory teams to guide products through development stages, clinical trials, and approvals.
  • Ensure timely product launches by managing timelines, resources, and key stakeholders.

Market Analysis & Consumer Insights:

  • Conduct in-depth market research to identify customer needs, competitive landscape, and potential opportunities for product improvement or expansion.
  • Gather and analyze feedback from customers, sales teams, and healthcare professionals to refine product offerings.

Sales & Marketing Support:

  • Support the development of product positioning and messaging that highlights the product's unique value proposition.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to the sales team to ensure they are equipped to effectively promote the product.
  • Track and analyze product performance, customer feedback, and sales trends to inform future strategies.

Financial Performance & Budgeting:

  • Monitor the financial performance of the product portfolio, including revenue, costs, and profitability.
  • Manage product budgets and collaborate with finance to ensure efficient allocation of resources.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Business, Marketing or a related field.
  • Experience in the therapeutic area relevant to the Obstetric & Gynaecology or Orthopaedics is preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience in product management, brand management, or related roles within the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, product lifecycle management, and market dynamics.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including regulatory, marketing, and sales.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

job.title: Junior Enterprise Sales Executive (Software / SaaS)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Information Technology sector to hire a Junior Enterprise Sales Executive. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Support the growth of the enterprise sales function by identifying new business opportunities, engaging prospective clients, and contributing to complex sales cycles.

Work closely with cross-functional teams to drive customer acquisition, strengthen client relationships, and support business growth across key markets.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Pipeline & Prospecting

  • Identify, research, and qualify enterprise prospects across multiple industries.
  • Conduct outreach through email, social platforms, events, and calls to generate new business opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate prospect information and pipeline visibility within CRM platforms.

Sales Support & Deal Execution

  • Support senior sales leaders in managing enterprise opportunities from qualification through to contract completion.
  • Prepare sales presentations, proposals, business cases, and solution summaries.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth progression of sales opportunities.
  • Participate in discovery sessions, product demonstrations, and customer workshops where required.

Customer Engagement

  • Understand customer challenges, objectives, operational processes, and procurement requirements.
  • Assist in preparing tailored demonstrations and value-driven presentations.
  • Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with prospects and customers.

Market & Product Knowledge

  • Stay updated on product offerings, market developments, and competitive activities.
  • Develop a strong understanding of enterprise software buying cycles, including procurement, compliance reviews, proof-of-concepts, and budgeting processes.
  • Share customer feedback and market insights with relevant internal teams.

Reporting & Administration

  • Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports.
  • Track sales KPIs including lead generation, pipeline coverage, opportunity volume, and conversion metrics.
  • Ensure compliance with internal sales processes and governance standards.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • 1-3 years of experience in software sales, technology sales, SaaS, business development, or a related commercial role.
  • Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles and customer acquisition activities.
  • Exposure to B2B or enterprise customers within Malaysia or the wider Southeast Asian region is advantageous.
  • Based in Kuala Lumpur or willing to relocate.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Familiarity with enterprise sales processes, software procurement, RFPs, vendor onboarding, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and commercial pricing models.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar tools.
  • Ability to understand technology solutions and communicate business value effectively.
  • Exposure to solution selling, technical scoping, or customer demonstrations is an advantage.
  • Understanding of subscription-based business models, software licensing, renewals, or recurring revenue environments is preferred.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage managers, directors, and senior stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated with a strong desire to develop a career in enterprise sales.
  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving abilities.
  • Customer-centric mindset with a consultative approach to selling.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
  • Strong organisational and relationship management skills.

Director of Resident Care - RN Licensed Registered Nurse Required Notre Dame du Lac Assisted Living Worcester, MA
Student Loan Repayment and Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250 /year; federal tax-exempt

Who We Are:
Notre Dame Health Care Center, Inc. (NDHCC) deeply rooted in the heritage of the Sisters of Notre Dame de Namur, is committed to the physical, spiritual, and emotional care of our residents and patients. Located off the shores of Lake Quinsigamond within the woods of the Worcester Land Trust, our 5 Star rated nationally recognized Assisted Living, Skilled Nursing Care, Hospice Care, and Educational Bridge Center provide high-quality compassionate care to the Central MA community.

Position Overview:
Adhering to NDHC’s mission and values, the Resident Care Director directs the delivery of all resident care while maintaining compliance with state, federal guidelines. Responsibilities include the following: supervision and development of department employees, care management, serve as member of organizations management team, development of strategic planning and quality assurance initiatives. This role directly supervises, motivates and encourages all resident care staff. An unwavering focus on customer service and resident and family relations are critical. The Director will lead by example with unwavering customer service demonstrated by healthy and thriving resident and family relationships.

Typical workday hours are Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 5:00PM.
Employee within this position not expected to work paid holidays.
Position is ultimately responsible for the Resident Care Department 24 hours a day.

job.title: Procurement Manager
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Procurement Manager. This opportunity is based in Klang, Selangor.
Position Overview
Lead the organisation's procurement function across metal, non-metal, and import logistics categories while ensuring cost-effective and reliable supply management.
Drive operational excellence, supplier performance, risk mitigation, and strategic sourcing initiatives that support the organisation's business objectives and long-term growth.
Key Responsibilities
• Responsible for all procurement activities (Metal, Non Metal and Import Logistics).
• Develop and formulate strategies on commodities and non-commodities procurement in line with company’s objective and focus.
• Minimize risk exposure in supply and service contracts and maximize opportunities in operations through supplier management.
• Ensure that goods and services are supplied on time via acceptable terms and conditions.
• Lead and develop high-performing purchasing and cost estimating teams to achieve objectives and drive continuous improvement.
• Lead and to ensure all purchases are manage via best practices according to Corporate, Company and Government Policies and to the best interest of the company and its stakeholders.
• Oversee the development of procurement and logistics processes and systems to ensure efficient delivery of goods and services at a reasonable cost.
• Identify potential suppliers, conduct vendor interviews, negotiate agreements, and manage contracts.
• Establish departmental objectives and assess direct reports' performance against KPIs.
• Provide reports on target achievements and recommend necessary actions.
Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
• Candidate must possess at least Bachelor's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Professional Degree in Business Management, Operation Management, Logistic/Transportation or equivalent.
• At least 10 Year(s) of working experience in the related field is required for this position.
• Preferable candidate with 5 years of managerial experience.
• Experience in Project Leadership or Change Management with long-term plan development or Sustainable Procurement is an added advantage.
Technical / Functional Expertise
• Experience managing procurement activities across Metal, Non Metal and Import Logistics categories.
• Strong commercial acumen and accomplished negotiator of high-value strategic contracts.
• Proven experience in supplier management, vendor selection, contract negotiation, and contract management.
• Experience overseeing procurement and logistics processes and systems.
• Planning Skills.
• Negotiation Skills.
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
• Leadership Skills.
• Communication Skills.
• Proven management skills with the ability to optimize team performance and development.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Possess leadership qualities and strong networking, collaboration, and well-developed team-working skills.
• Experience leading teams, driving continuous improvement, and managing stakeholder relationships effectively.

job.title: FP&A Manager
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire an FP&A Manager. This opportunity is based in Klang, Selangor.
Position Overview
Lead financial planning, analysis, forecasting, and business performance management activities to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Drive financial insights, profitability improvement, and budgeting excellence while partnering with leadership to achieve sustainable business growth.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Modelling & Analysis
  • Create, maintain, and update financial models to support business planning and strategic decision making.
  • Develop scenario analyses to assess financial impacts and business outcomes.
  • Analyse business performance, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations to management.
Profitability & Cost Analysis
  • Analyse product costing and profitability (by SKU, customer and segment)
  • Monitor contribution margins and cost structures
  • Support pricing strategies and margin enhancement initiatives
  • Identify cost optimisation and efficiency improvement opportunities
  • Develop financial models for revenue, cost, and profitability projections
  • Conduct scenario analysis and sensitivity analysis to assess risks and opportunities
  • Evaluate new markets, product launches, and expansion projects
  • Deliver actionable insights to support data-driven decision-making
Financial & Cost Management: Budgeting & Forecasting
  • Lead the annual budgeting process across all departments.
  • Manage and prepare monthly rolling forecasts, including variance analysis and performance tracking.
  • Ensure alignment between budget assumptions, strategic priorities, and financial targets.
Strategic Financial Planning
  • Work closely with the CEO and senior management to support long-term financial planning.
  • Provide insights and financial perspectives on business initiatives, capital investments, and operational improvements.
  • Translate financial data into clear, concise reports for decision-making.
Business Partnering
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand operational drivers and financial implications.
  • Support department heads in monitoring budgets, identifying risks, and developing mitigation plans.
  • Offer financial guidance on new projects, growth opportunities, and cost optimisation efforts.
Reporting & Compliance
  • Prepare accurate, timely financial reports and dashboards for management review.
  • Ensure financial analysis and reporting adhere to internal policies and standards.
  • Support internal and external audit activities as needed.
Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
  • Possess a Professional Qualification or a Bachelor's Degree in Finance/Accounting.
  • 5-7 years of financial planning and analysis experience with progressive responsibility.
  • Prior experience in the manufacturing industry will be an advantage.
Technical / Functional Expertise
  • Advanced hands on knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Power BI.
  • Experience in financial modelling, scenario analysis, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Strong capability in budgeting, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, and performance tracking.
  • Experience analysing product costing and profitability (by SKU, customer and segment).
  • Knowledge of contribution margins, cost structures, pricing strategies, and margin enhancement initiatives.
  • Ability to develop financial models for revenue, cost, and profitability projections.
  • Experience evaluating new markets, product launches, and expansion projects.
  • Ability to prepare accurate financial reports, dashboards, and management insights.
  • Experience providing ad-hoc financial reports and analyses for special projects, such as mergers and acquisitions or new product launches.
  • Understanding of financial reporting, compliance requirements, and audit support activities.
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
  • High attention to detail and the ability to work independently.
  • Able to execute responsibilities, meet rigorous deadlines and manage multiple competing priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to provide actionable recommendations.
  • Strong business partnering and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate financial data into clear business insights.
  • Commercial mindset with the ability to support strategic decision-making and business growth initiatives.

job.title: Chief Operating Officer
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial & Construction sector to hire a Chief Operating Officer (COO). This opportunity is based in Selangor, Malaysia.
Position Overview
Lead the overall business operations to drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, profitability, and customer satisfaction across the organisation.
Provide executive leadership in shaping operational and commercial strategies while ensuring profitable project delivery, strong governance, and long-term business competitiveness.
Key Responsibilities
Business & Strategic Leadership
  • Develop and execute the company's operational strategy aligned with corporate vision and business objectives.
  • Drive sustainable revenue growth, profitability, operational excellence, and market competitiveness.
  • Lead annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic initiatives.
  • Identify new business opportunities, partnerships, and market expansion strategies.
  • Provide strategic recommendations to the Group CEO and Executive Management on business performance and future direction.
Operational Excellence
  • Lead the overall operations of the business, including Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication, Installation, Procurement and Logistics.
  • Ensure projects are completed within budget, timeline, quality, and safety requirements.
  • Establish operational governance, performance management systems, and business KPIs.
  • Drive productivity improvement, operational efficiency, and cost optimisation initiatives.
Commercial & Financial Performance
  • Own the overall Profit & Loss (P&L) performance.
  • Drive business profitability through effective project execution, cost control, productivity improvement, and resource optimisation.
  • Review tender strategies, project pricing, commercial risks, and contract negotiations.
  • Monitor project profitability, cash flow, working capital, and operational budgets.
Project & Customer Delivery
  • Provide executive oversight on all roofing, façade cladding, architectural metal, and steel structure projects.
  • Ensure effective project governance from tender award through project completion.
  • Resolve major project, contractual, commercial, or operational issues.
  • Maintain strong relationships with key clients, consultants, architects, developers, contractors, and strategic partners.
Health, Safety, Quality & Compliance
  • Champion a strong safety culture across workshop and site operations.
  • Ensure compliance with CIDB, DOSH, ISO, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Lead incident investigations and corrective action implementation.
  • Drive quality management and continuous improvement programs.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
  • Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, architects, developers, and contractors.
  • Participate in project meetings and strategic customer engagements.
  • Ensure high customer satisfaction through effective project delivery.
  • Support business development initiatives by providing technical and operational expertise.
People Leadership
  • Lead and develop project managers, engineers, supervisors, site teams, and support functions.
  • Establish succession plans and capability development programs.
  • Drive a performance-oriented culture with clear accountability.
  • Foster collaboration across departments.
Strategic Growth
  • Identify opportunities to expand operational capabilities and market presence.
  • Evaluate new technologies, fabrication methods, and installation techniques.
  • Support expansion into regional projects in line with company growth ambitions.
Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Architecture, or related field.
  • Possess at least 15-20 years of experience in construction, roofing, façade, cladding, steel structures, or building materials industries and minimum 10 years in a senior leadership position.
  • Proven track record of managing full business operations with accountability for P&L, operational performance, and strategic growth.
Technical / Functional Expertise
  • Demonstrated experience managing Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication, Installation, Procurement and Logistics functions.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in tender strategies, project pricing, commercial risk assessment, and contract negotiations.
  • Proven expertise in driving project profitability, cash flow management, working capital optimisation, and operational budget control.
  • Experience establishing operational governance frameworks, performance management systems, and business KPIs.
  • Strong understanding of roofing, façade cladding, architectural metal, and steel structure projects.
  • Knowledge of CIDB, DOSH, ISO, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Experience leading quality management, incident investigations, corrective action implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to evaluate and implement new technologies, fabrication methods, and installation techniques.
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
  • Excellent command of English, with the ability to communicate and deliver presentations effectively.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead both direct teams and cross-functional departments, integrating complex initiatives across multiple business areas.
  • Exceptional organisational and time management skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to drive business growth, operational excellence, and organisational transformation.
  • Ability to foster collaboration, accountability, and a high-performance culture across the organisation.

job.title: R&D Director
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Director, Research & Development (R&D). This opportunity is based in Klang, Selangor, Malaysia.
Position Overview
Lead the research and development function to drive innovation, product development, and process improvement in specialised coating solutions.
Play a key role in strengthening the organisation's competitive position through technological advancement, operational excellence, and customer-focused innovation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement the R&D strategy aligned with the company's vision and market demands for coated fin.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and competitor developments to maintain a competitive edge particularly, in the microelectronics sector, where new technological developments are occurring continuously specifically in paint coating technology.
  • Deliver & re-engineer process flow to ensure new products (paint) are cost competitive & consistently staying ahead of market.
  • Lead new product development activities from inception to product launch and customer acceptance including overseeing the design, testing, and production of new aluminium/coating related products.
  • Provide leadership and guidance for non-routine problems requiring substantial judgment in the independent evaluation, selection and adaptation of standard engineering techniques, procedures and criteria.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including production, sales, and marketing, to ensure alignment of R&D projects with business objectives.
  • Track project schedules in conjunction with product management preparing to manage the R&D budget, ensuring cost-effective utilization of resources.
  • Take charge in the internal communication – to discuss the current issues in operations, daily and weekly and external communication – to experiment /develop new type of coating. Review feedback for continuous improvement on paint for added value.
  • Ensure all products and processes comply with local and international regulations and implement rigorous quality control and assurance practices.
  • Responsible to oversee and manage Customer Service department, including monitoring and reporting metrics such as productivity, response speed and any metric which affect the quality of service.
Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
  • PhD in Engineering (Others), Project Management, Research Development or equivalent.
  • At least 10 to 15 years of working experience in a related field.
  • Japanese nationality/speaking candidate is preferred (expert in aluminium/aluminium coating).
Technical / Functional Expertise
  • Strong knowledge of aluminium alloys, extrusion processes, and surface treatments.
  • Experience in paint coating technology and aluminium/coating related product development.
  • Ability to lead a direct team and a multifunctional organisation, integrating complex efforts across multiple business areas.
  • Experience managing new product development activities from inception through product launch and customer acceptance.
  • Knowledge of quality control, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Experience in project schedule tracking, product management coordination, and R&D budget management.
  • Proficient in numerical and analytical skills.
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
  • Forward-thinking mindset.
  • Good interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities.
  • Strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to guide cross-functional teams and manage stakeholder relationships.

job.title: Marketing Manager
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Marketing Manager. This opportunity is based in Klang, Selangor.
Position Overview
Lead the development and execution of strategic marketing initiatives to strengthen brand positioning, market presence, and business growth within the building and construction industry.
Drive brand performance, customer engagement, and commercial success through effective marketing, specification activities, stakeholder partnerships, and team leadership.
Key Responsibilities
  • Explore and identify strategic business partner to enhance roofing offer to the market.
  • Market and specify products in the Building, Roofing & Construction industry.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with agencies and external vendors to drive performance. Review feedback and learnings from campaigns with agencies for continuous improvement.
  • Manage all marketing activities within the marketing budget and target.
  • Develop and execute marketing strategy for the company to meet the target.
  • Serve as an internal event consultant, strategizing and managing end-to-end logistics for brand and product events to meet business objectives.
  • Understand brand objectives and identify opportunities to enhance branding and engagement through innovative brand activation programs. Initiate new ideas and concepts to drive brand objectives.
  • Collaborate with the Sales & Marketing Director to strategize, develop, and implement comprehensive marketing plans, from creative ideation to execution of both offline and online brand activation programs.
  • Lead and manage the development of key campaigns targeting specific audiences, from budget planning and campaign ideation to managing end-to-end logistics for go-to-market execution.
  • Manage and lead the marketing and technical marketing (specification) team members to achieve desired results. Address issues and barriers affecting the implementation of brand projects and formulate effective action plans.
  • Develop, implement, and manage social media strategies. Define key social media KPIs, oversee social media content, and ensure effective engagement.
  • Support and collaborate with internal stakeholders. Analyze and create post-mortem reports on all marketing campaigns to measure success and gain insights.
Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
  • Candidate must possess Bachelor's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Professional Degree in Marketing/ Sales/ Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 8 Year(s) of collective working experience in Sales and Marketing background and 4 Years of managerial experience in brand/product management/marketing, preferably in the Building Material/Construction industry.
  • Proven track record of delivering top-line results and meeting marketing KPIs (driving share and penetration).
  • Proven experience in implementing brand and execution plans.
  • Agency management experience (advertising/digital/media agency).
Technical / Functional Expertise
  • Strong understanding of marketing, product specifications, sales, and finance to drive brand performance.
  • Experience in leading specifying and technical marketing with the architectural community is advantageous. Candidates with a network of architects are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience liaising with Pertubuhan Akitek Malaysia (PAM) is preferred.
  • Marketing Communication (MARCOM) is fundamental.
  • Experience developing and executing marketing strategies, brand activation programmes, and go-to-market campaigns.
  • Experience managing social media strategies, social media KPIs, content development, and engagement initiatives.
  • Ability to manage marketing budgets, campaign performance analysis, and post-mortem reporting.
  • Experience working with agencies and external vendors to drive marketing performance.
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
  • Ability to lead a direct team and a multifunctional organization, integrating complex efforts across multiple business areas.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with a high attention to detail.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to develop strategic partnerships and drive collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working on both routine and ad-hoc requirements.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously.
  • This position requires job-related travel.

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
An executive recruitment company, Monroe Consulting Group is partnering with an international non-profit organization to hire an Administrative Assistant to support its East Malaysia Project Team in the implementation and coordination of program activities.

The successful candidate will provide administrative, logistical, documentation, reporting, and stakeholder coordination support to ensure the smooth delivery of training programs, workshops, meetings, and other project initiatives. This is a remote-based position located in East Malaysia, with travel required within Malaysia and regionally as needed.

Job Responsibilities:

Program & Project Support

  • Support the planning, coordination, and implementation of project activities, training programs, workshops, and events.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, partners, trainers, speakers, and facilitators to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Monitor program progress against established targets and timelines.
  • Support continuous improvement of program processes and activities.

Stakeholder Engagement & Coordination

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with government agencies, NGOs, partners, and other project stakeholders.
  • Coordinate meetings, training sessions, workshops, and other stakeholder engagements.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with trainers, speakers, facilitators, and external resource persons.

Research, Data & Reporting

  • Conduct desktop research related to human trafficking and forced labor.
  • Collect, organize, and analyze program data to support monitoring and evaluation.
  • Conduct and analyze pre- and post-training assessments.
  • Support quarterly and annual reporting, work plans, evaluations, and program updates.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records and databases.

Documentation & Administration

  • Prepare meeting minutes, letters, reports, presentations, briefings, and other project documentation.
  • Maintain accurate records of program activities, expenditures, outcomes, and supporting documents.
  • Support data quality checks and ensure timely updates to program databases.
  • Assist with payment requests, expense reports, procurement documentation, and other administrative processes.

Events & Logistics

  • Coordinate logistics for training programs, workshops, meetings, and project activities.
  • Support venue arrangements, travel, accommodation, transportation, materials, and equipment requirements.
  • Assist with itinerary planning and logistics for staff visits and external stakeholder meetings.
  • Liaise with Finance and Administration teams to ensure timely processing of payments and expenses.

Budget & Resource Management

  • Support program budgeting, procurement, and allocation of resources.
  • Monitor program-related expenditure and ensure appropriate documentation.
  • Assist in ensuring resources are utilized efficiently within approved budgets.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences, Political Science, International Relations, Communications, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in administration, program coordination, project support, NGO, government, or related environments.
  • Experience working with government agencies and/or NGOs is preferred.
  • Understanding or experience relating to human trafficking and forced labor is highly advantageous.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Malaysia.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; database management experience is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated experience in administrative and logistical coordination, particularly for meetings, workshops, conferences, or training programs.
  • Experience supporting budget management, procurement, expense reporting, and resource coordination.
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote/home-based or field-based environment.
  • Willingness to travel within East Malaysia and regionally as required.
  • Preference will be given to candidates based in East Malaysia.

job.title: Marketing and Communications Copywriter
job.description:
Marketing and Communications Copywriter

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Professional Services industry to hire a Marketing and Communications Copywriter. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

The Marketing and Communications Copywriter plays a vital role in strengthening the organisation's position as a leader in its sector through strategic, high-quality communications and content creation.

The role contributes to preserving and enhancing the organisation's culture, reputation, and brand presence by delivering engaging content across multiple communication channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Integration: Collaborating with the Content Specialist and the Advancement team to integrate all social media and digital content plans with overall marketing and advancement objectives.
  • Marketing and Advancement Copywriting: Writing clear, persuasive copy for admissions, marketing, and advancement materials, including brochures, advertisements (print and digital), landing pages, and marketing campaigns.
  • Long-Form Digital Development: Developing high-quality, long-form content for the school's website, blog (e.g., educational thought leadership), email newsletters (EDMs), and admissions-focused email campaigns.
  • Platform-Specific Social Media Creation: Creating engaging, platform-specific copy, posts, and captions for all official school social media channels (e.g., Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok).
  • Content Calendar Management: Developing and managing a daily social media content calendar that strategically aligns content with school events, admissions cycles, and key content pillars (e.g., academic excellence, student life, alumni success).
  • Authentic Community Storytelling: Proactively sourcing, capturing, and generating authentic, in-the-moment content, including developing short-form video scripts (Reels/Stories) and photo captions, highlighting the student and faculty experience.
  • Quality Control and Proofreading: Serving as the final quality control for all public-facing text, meticulously proofreading and editing to ensure impeccable grammar, adherence to brand style guides, and complete factual accuracy.
  • Policy Compliance: Ensuring all social media content strictly complies with school privacy policies regarding student, employee, and community members' photo/video usage.
  • Other Duties: Performing other related duties as assigned.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in any field.
  • Preferably with at least 5 years of related experience.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • High-quality writing and content production delivered with speed and precision, demonstrating the ability to quickly grasp and produce content across diverse subject areas.
  • Demonstrates strong oral and written communication skills in English with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Skilled at tailoring written communication to meet the needs of diverse audiences with varying levels of language proficiency and subject expertise.
  • Significant experience in writing in various formats and for a range of techniques under the PR/content umbrella, including social media, blogs, advertorials, newsletters, video scripts, media releases, and feature stories.
  • Knowledge of media production, communication, and dissemination techniques and methods. This includes alternative ways to inform and entertain via written, oral, and visual media.
  • Extensive experience in using automated marketing platforms, email marketing services, social media management, and optimisation platforms.
  • Understanding of PDPA requirements related to marketing and digital communications.
  • Experience in creating content for websites, blogs, EDMs, social media channels, digital campaigns, marketing materials, and corporate communication assets.
  • Understanding of SEO techniques and content optimisation.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Social Chameleon: The ability to switch tones effortlessly, from interviewing a Middle School student to a senior faculty member or responding to a concerned parent online.
  • Empathy & Inclusivity: A warm personality that makes people feel comfortable being filmed or photographed, with a strong appreciation for diversity and inclusion in an international setting.
  • Strategic Anticipation: Ability to pivot quickly when a storytelling opportunity arises, managing the tension between a fixed schedule and a fast-moving environment.
  • Critical Observation: Ability to identify compelling stories and content opportunities.
  • Brand Stewardship: A sharp eye for brand voice and the ability to determine whether content aligns with brand standards.
  • Prioritisation: Strong judgement to determine which tasks require immediate attention and which can be scheduled for later.
  • Stakeholder Diplomacy: Ability to follow up on approvals or content requests effectively while maintaining positive working relationships.
  • Feedback Resilience: Ability to accept creative feedback from multiple stakeholders and incorporate it constructively into the final output.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills with the ability to engage a diverse range of stakeholders.

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Information Technology sector to hire a Product Manager. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Support the end-to-end product lifecycle of enterprise technology solutions, translating customer insights and business needs into scalable product capabilities.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative digital products that drive operational efficiency, customer value, and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Product Discovery & Requirements Definition

  • Support in gathering customer feedback, deployment learnings, and market insights across enterprise clients.
  • Translate operational challenges into structured product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Conduct competitive analysis on emerging technology platforms and enterprise software solutions.
  • Maintain a prioritised backlog aligned with commercial impact, technical feasibility, and business objectives.

Feature Delivery & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner with Engineering and technical teams to drive features from concept through release.
  • Coordinate sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release cycles using Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Track feature-level KPIs and provide updates to product leadership.
  • Own and maintain product documentation, including PRDs, release notes, and enablement materials.

Customer & Market Insights

  • Partner with commercial and delivery teams to capture customer and market feedback.
  • Synthesise customer requests, deployment findings, and growth opportunities into actionable product recommendations.
  • Support user research activities, including interviews, usability testing, and feature validation.
  • Contribute to product positioning and messaging initiatives.

Product Operations & Governance

  • Maintain product roadmaps, release calendars, and decision logs.
  • Support QA activities and feature acceptance testing prior to deployment.
  • Participate in product reviews, retrospectives, and roadmap prioritisation discussions.
  • Ensure product releases align with governance, compliance, and security requirements.

Commercial & Go-to-Market Support

  • Support solution scoping activities and product demonstrations.
  • Develop product briefings and enablement materials for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist with proposal development by mapping product capabilities to customer use cases.
  • Feed customer and deployment insights back into the product roadmap.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.
  • 1-3 years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, Technology Delivery, Consulting, or a related field.
  • Exposure to AI, analytics, enterprise software, digital platforms, or technology solutions is highly preferred.
  • Experience working within technology companies, consulting firms, start-ups, or enterprise environments is advantageous.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong interest in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and intelligent automation technologies.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements into structured product artefacts, including PRDs, user stories, and roadmap initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid product delivery methodologies.
  • Experience supporting product discovery, requirements gathering, and feature delivery.
  • Knowledge of product analytics tools; SQL exposure is an advantage.
  • Understanding of enterprise software, workflow automation, analytics platforms, or digital transformation solutions.
  • Exposure to user research, product launches, go-to-market initiatives, or UI/UX principles is beneficial.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to balance customer requirements, business goals, and technical considerations.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive and continuous learning mindset.

job.title: Construction Engineer - Post-tensioned building or bridge projects
job.description:
Job Role: Construction Engineer
Responsibilities:
  • Handle site operations, including planning project work schedules and controlling project costs.
  • Assist Managers and Senior Engineers in preparing Site Activity Reports (SAR) and prepare bi-weekly or monthly Progress Reports for submission.
  • Conduct resource planning for manpower, materials, and equipment required for the project.
  • Liaise with clients on-site regarding work-related matters.
  • Review shop drawings from the Design Department and clients to address any on-site construction issues.
  • Troubleshoot on-site problems to minimize delays and reduce additional costs.
  • Ensure compliance with quality standards and assist in coordinating inspections and documentation within assigned site scopes.
  • Support the Site Manager in identifying non-conformities and assisting in their resolution with reference to project specifications.
  • Provide technical and practical support to Supervisors and Foremen during construction activities.
  • Monitor material wastage and on-site productivity to reduce wastage.
  • Ensure compliance with the company’s IMS processes and procedures.
  • Conduct OSH risk assessment and implement EMS impact & aspect registers.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of all construction-related site activities, including work progress, resource usage, and daily operations.
  • Ensure that relevant QA/QC documents (e.g., inspection reports, test results) are completed and submitted as part of regular site reporting.
  • Carry out procurement of materials and equipment in accordance with company policies and delegated authority.
  • Coordinate the delivery, retrieval, and inter-site transfer of materials and equipment to and from project sites and storage facilities. Ensure all transactions are properly documented using the relevant delivery and material transfer forms.
  • Maintain accurate documentation related to construction activities, including delivery records, material transfer forms, permits, inspections, technical reports, and monthly stock take reports.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering.
  • Must be a Licensed Civil Engineer.
  • At least three (3) years of relevant experience in post-tensioned building or bridge projects is an advantage.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Independent, resourceful, diligent, and able to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Willing to be assigned to project sites anywhere in the Philippines as required.

job.title: Senior Area Sales Manager
job.description:
Senior Area Sales Manager, BU Egg

Location: Malaysia

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment Firm, is partnering with a leading organisation within the Industrial sector to hire a Senior Area Sales Manager, BU Egg based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead the growth and commercial performance of the company's egg business unit by developing business opportunities, driving sales strategies, and strengthening market presence across the region.
This role plays a critical part in achieving revenue, profitability, and market share objectives while supporting product development, customer engagement, and regional collaboration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the Company's Egg sales-related activities including developing new business, growth strategies and opportunities and maximising long-term profitable volume growth.
  • Realise sales budget (target) both in volume, margin and market share.
  • Analyse the market and determine the sales strategy including a market-specific pricing policy.
  • Participate in generating "Proven Solutions", sales manuals, product and solution templates for proposals, meetings, workshops and other specific sales material.
  • Recommend and take part in trade shows and other relevant marketing projects.
  • Resolve customer complaints regarding sales and service and manage key client relationships.
  • Recommend and implement detailed annual sales operating plans and preparation of sales performance reports for strategic analysis and review on a monthly or quarterly basis.
  • Collect and share product ideas/market requirements. Actively participate in the design of BU Egg related products in collaboration with the customer solutions, engineering and HQ.
  • Assist in the roll out of new products to the relevant countries in our region.
  • Assist and lead the project sales with consulting on farm management level.
  • Determine training requirements for BU Egg sales team.
  • Liaise with respective Asia regions to conduct BU Egg product trainings regionally.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Animal Production or any other equivalent qualification.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in investment goods with relevant experience as a Sales Manager with P&L responsibilities.
  • Those with sales production or sales engineering experience in the fields of agriculture shall be favourably considered.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Proven ability to develop new business, growth strategies and market opportunities.
  • Experience in achieving sales budgets covering volume, margin and market share targets.
  • Strong market analysis and sales strategy development capabilities, including pricing strategy formulation.
  • Experience in developing sales materials, solution proposals, sales manuals and product templates.
  • Ability to prepare detailed annual sales operating plans and sales performance reports for strategic review.
  • Experience in product development collaboration with customer solutions, engineering and head office stakeholders.
  • Exposure to new product rollout initiatives across multiple countries.
  • Experience leading project sales and providing farm management-level consultation.
  • Knowledge of training needs assessment and sales capability development programmes.
  • Ability to work across regional teams to coordinate and conduct product training programmes.
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the Asia region.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Excellent business acumen with a proven business track record.
  • Excellent networking and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive and able to work independently.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong leadership and coaching skills with evidence of building, retaining and motivating a high-performing sales team.

job.title: Business Development Manager - MVR
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Business Development Manager - MVR. This opportunity is based in Southeast Asia & Oceania.
Position Overview
Lead the growth and market expansion of Mechanical Vapor Recompression (MVR) systems across Southeast Asia and Oceania through strategic business development, solution selling, and project leadership.
Drive the adoption of sustainable evaporation and process efficiency solutions while delivering commercial growth, successful project execution, and long-term customer value.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Market Expansion
  • Drive regional business growth for Mechanical Vapor Recompression systems across Southeast Asia and Oceania.
  • Identify priority markets, applications, and customer segments where MVR delivers strong sustainability, energy-saving, and process-efficiency value.
  • Develop and execute a focused go-to-market strategy for industries such as chemical processing, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, solvent recovery, wastewater treatment, and Zero Liquid Discharge applications.
  • Build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities through direct customer engagement, channel collaboration, EPC partnerships, and internal network development.
  • Position MVR as a strategic solution for customers seeking lower operating costs, reduced steam dependency, improved water recovery, and lower CO₂ footprint.

6. Commercial Performance & Business Ownership
  • Own the regional MVR opportunity pipeline and drive disciplined follow-up through CRM and structured review processes.
  • Deliver growth in orders, revenue, profitability, market share, and reference installations.

Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
